items.text: In adults consulting network practices for dental pain, does a dental pain pathway (decision aid, same-day dental telephone triage and analgesia advice) reduce the proportion of consultations with an antibiotic prescription within 3 days, compared with usual care, over 12 months?
items.population: Adults consulting 11 network practices for dental pain
items.outcome: Antibiotic prescription within 3 days of the consultation

finer: Feasible with routine coded data and the 12-month triage line; interesting to the microbiology team; novel in a district with poor dental access; ethical if the consent question is resolved; relevant to antimicrobial stewardship.
summary: One PICOT question with allocation at practice level.
